name: Sundklakkstraumen Bridge
facts: The Sundklakkstraumen Bridge, a cantilever road bridge, opened in 1976, spanning 271 metres across the Sundklakkstraumen strait to link the islands of Gimsøya and Vestvågøya.
With a main span of 90 metres, the bridge is a key segment of the European route E10, one of many crossings that knit together the Lofoten archipelago.
Constructed in the mid‑1970s, the bridge exemplifies Norway’s engineering prowess in creating durable, long‑span structures over rugged coastal waters.
